post.title: How Planet Fitness makes money from January joiners
post.ig:
Planet Fitness averages about 7,200 members per club (our math: 20.8 million members / 2,896 clubs at the end of 2025).
Its fiscal 2025 10-K says member joins are typically higher in January than in other months.
Members went from about 20.8 million (Dec 31, 2025) to 21.5 million (Mar 31, 2026), and were still 21.5 million on Sept 30, 2026.
Average monthly dues were $19.51 per member as of Dec 31, 2025, plus a standard $49 annual fee. A 2006 study of three US gyms (not Planet Fitness) found members on monthly plans over $70 paid over $17 per visit when a 10-visit pass cost $10 per visit.
Sources: Planet Fitness FY2025 10-K and 2025-2026 results releases; DellaVigna & Malmendier, American Economic Review, 2006.
News and education, not financial advice.
